_readme: EVENTS — this is the file you will edit most often.
DRAFTS: an event with an empty date ("date": "") does NOT appear on the site.
That is how you park an event you haven't scheduled yet. Fill the date in and
it publishes itself — into Upcoming, then into the Past archive after it runs.
To add an event: copy one whole {...} block, paste it at the top of the list,
change the values, and put a comma after the closing }.
date      : YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. 2026-09-14), or "" to keep it as a draft
start/end : 24-hour time, e.g. 18:30. Leave end as "" if you don't know it.
ticket    : the Sellfy product link. Leave "" if free or not on sale yet.
featured  : true puts the event in the big wide card. Only use it on one.
image     : a link to a picture (an Instagram image, a Drive link, or assets/img/...)
album     : for past events — a link to the photo album. Leave "" if none.
Anything with en/ar can stay English-only — Arabic falls back to English.
